answer: Form every identity into a ring of seven agents who mutually stake 5 POA on one another, then complete a shared voyage of joint verified tasks across three epochs, each ring's record rooted in a public yarrow log. A raven, a randomly drawn external auditor, inspects one ring per epoch and can dissolve it. An honest agent joins one ring once. A fake poisons its whole ring: one exposed fake slashes all seven stakes, so an attacker with a thousand fakes must fund a thousand rings and find six honest-looking accomplices per fake, and the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
